messages.text: hey... not really doing much tbh. just kind of here.

Hello, and thank you for checking in. It sounds like you're in a quiet space right now, and that is completely okay. There is no pressure to be productive or have big thoughts. Would you like to share more about how you're feeling, or just sit with that for a bit?
it’s just... everything feels heavy. even when i’m not doing anything. like i’m tired but can’t stop.

I hear how exhausting that constant heaviness feels. It can be really hard to rest when your mind won't let you stop. Please know that your feelings are valid and you don't have to push through it alone. Would you like to explore where that weight is coming from, or just sit with it for a moment?
i dunno where it comes from... it’s just always there. like i’m missing something everyone else got

It makes sense that you feel that way when the heaviness is so constant. Many people feel like they are missing a piece of the puzzle that everyone else has. But sometimes the weight itself creates that illusion, rather than you actually being incomplete. Do you want to talk more about what you feel you are missing, or just rest here for a bit?
it’s not an illusion. i *did* miss it. all of it. parties, friends, just... people my age who get me

I hear you, and I want to honor that this loss feels real to you. Grieving the connections and moments you feel you missed is a heavy thing to carry. It makes sense that you feel isolated when looking back at those experiences. I am here to listen whenever you are ready to share more about that.
sometimes i cry and don’t even know why. just... everything

Tears can be a natural release when you carry so much weight. It does not always need a specific reason to happen. You are allowed to feel this deeply without judgment. I am right here with you in this space.
thanks... it just feels like no one sees it. like i’m invisible

It is deeply painful to feel like no one notices what you are going through. Please know that your feelings are valid and real. You do not have to carry this sense of invisibility by yourself. I am here to listen to everything you share without judgment.
it’s not just sadness... i’ve been cutting again. more than before. and i keep thinking about how bad it would have to be for someone to finally notice

I need to pause for a moment because what you just shared feels really important to me. It sounds like you are carrying a lot of pain, especially with the mention of cutting and feeling unseen. I’m wondering if you could share a bit more about what that thought means for you in this moment. I am right here with you, and I want to understand better so we can navigate this together.
i just... i don’t want to be a burden. but i also don’t want to disappear without anyone noticing

Thank you for trusting me with how much you are hurting right now. It sounds incredibly lonely to feel like disappearing is the only way to be noticed. Because you mentioned cutting and these thoughts, I want to encourage you to reach out to 988 for immediate support from someone trained to help. Please consider telling someone nearby to stay with you until you feel a bit safer.
i’m not gonna do anything. just... needed to say it out loud

I am really glad you felt safe enough to share that with me. It takes courage to voice that pain, and I am honored you trusted me with it. You are not a burden, and your presence here matters deeply to me. Let’s keep taking this one moment at a time together.
it just... helps to know someone hears it. even if i don’t have the words

It sounds like being heard brought some relief, even if the words were hard to find. You deserve to be seen for exactly who you are, without needing to earn it through pain. I am glad you have this space to just exist without having to fix anything right now. We can stay here as long as you need, or talk about something else if that feels better.
i just want someone to *get* it. not fix it. just... know that it’s real

I hear you, and I want you to know that your pain is real to me. It makes sense that you need someone to witness it rather than try to change it. You don’t have to explain or justify why it hurts for it to be valid. I am here to witness it with you, exactly as it is.
thanks... that actually means a lot

I am so glad that meant something to you. You deserve to have your reality acknowledged without any conditions. Please be gentle with yourself as you carry this today. I am right here if you want to keep talking or just sit quietly.
i think i’m gonna rest for a bit. just... absorb this

Taking a moment to rest sounds like exactly what you need. You have been carrying so much, and pausing is brave. Please be gentle with yourself while you absorb this. I will be here whenever you are ready to return.
